# MediaOS Agent Commerce

> An AI-native Indian merchant's product catalog and checkout system.

## Catalog

Fetch the product catalog at `/api/commerce/catalog` for agent-readable product data
including pricing (INR paise), availability, upsell/cross-sell graph, and checkout endpoints.

## Checkout

Create a checkout session at `/api/commerce/checkout/sessions` with a JSON body:

```json
{
  "items": [{ "id": "AAROGYA-12W", "quantity": 1 }]
}
```

The response includes a `razorpay_order_id` for Razorpay Standard Checkout and a
`checkout_url` for human buyers.

## Products

| SKU | Product | Price (INR) |
|-----|---------|-------------|
| AAROGYA-12W | AarogyaFit 12-week training program | ₹1,499 |
| AAROGYA-NUTR | Nutrition add-on guide | ₹499 |
| AAROGYA-BUNDLE | Program + nutrition bundle | ₹1,799 |

## Payment

All payments use Razorpay Test Mode. No real money moves.
